Definition: apparently from a simpler (obsolete) form of ὑδέω (to celebrate; probably akin to G103; compare H5667); a "hymn" or religious ode (one of the Psalms):--hymn.
BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, hýmnos is the word for a hymn. In Ephesians 5:19, the text says "Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs."
TheologicalSignificance: I take hýmnos as it stands: a hymn.
